data.name: Alicia
data.long_meaning: The name Alicia is derived from the Latin 'alicus', which means 'noble' or 'most beautiful'. In Christian tradition, it was often given to girls born in noble families. In the Bible, there is no character named Alicia, but it is a popular name among Christian saints. The most famous of these is Saint Alicia of Cordoba, a Spanish martyr who lived during the 10th century.
